description: Replace a flyer, page, t-shirt or brochure with a full edited document, in its own kind's grammar (see read_artifact / language_reference). The parsed document's kind must match the artifact's stored kind — this tool edits a document, it never changes what kind an artifact is. A parse error, or a kind mismatch, refuses and writes nothing.

dsl.description: The full document source, in its kind's own grammar

name: apply_artifact
title: Apply a whole artifact document
